principle: Developer delivery state is projected onto the same canonical spatial graph. Procurement may be native to Product Twin or imported from external ERP/contractor systems.

status_palette_semantics.green: complete / installed / accepted for current milestone
status_palette_semantics.grey: not required yet / not in current milestone

spatial_queries: show materials required in next 14 days
show ordered items not yet allocated to a unit
show products on site but not installed
show units unable to reach practical completion
show all bathrooms using product/system X
show expected versus actual installed progress

integration_model.rule: Externally procured items may still be canonical Product Twins and participate in status, performance and as-built graphs.

commercial_modes.description: Developer uses Product Twin control/performance graph while procurement remains external.
Product Twin resolves products/suppliers and integrates selected external purchasing routes.
Product Twin coordinates RFQs/orders/logistics and captures commercial margin/referral where appropriate.
